chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Sahl al-Ahl al-Ash'ari from his father who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who deliberately reads in the Friday prayer without Surah al-Jumu'ah. He said, 'There is no harm.'
ai.seo_question: Is it necessary to recite Surah al-Jumu'ah in Friday prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that reciting Surah al-Jumu'ah is not a strict condition for the validity of the Friday prayer, even if omitted deliberately. This ruling underscores the flexibility in the recitation of Quranic chapters during congregational prayers, distinguishing between obligatory pillars and recommended acts within Shia jurisprudence. It reflects the broader principle that the core validity of Salah remains intact despite the omission of specific surahs, provided the essential components are fulfilled.
